title: GPT-5.5 System Card
summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.5 系统卡，详细披露了该模型的安全评估、能力边界和潜在风险。作为 OpenAI 迄今最智能的模型，GPT-5.5 在 Agent 能力、编码和推理上大幅提升，系统卡为开发者提供了关键的技术参考和安全指南。

title: Introducing GPT-5.5
raw_excerpt: Introducing GPT-5.5, our smartest model yet—faster, more capable, and built for complex tasks like coding, research, and data analysis across tools.
summary: OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-5.5，号称其最智能模型，在 Agent 能力上实现重大突破：能自主规划、调用工具并执行多步骤复杂任务。相比前代，Token 成本降至 1/35，输出提速 50 倍，在 SWE-Bench Pro 等基准上表现优异。

title: DeepSeek-V4: a million-token context that agents can actually use
summary: DeepSeek 发布 V4 模型，支持百万 token 上下文，并针对 Agent 场景优化，使长上下文真正可用。该模型在多项基准上表现强劲，进一步巩固了 DeepSeek 在开源大模型领域的领先地位。

title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
raw_excerpt: Qwen3.6-27B delivers flagship-level agentic coding performance. The Qwen team claims that it surpasses the previous-generation flagship Qwen3.5-397B-A17B across all major coding benchmarks. The model is 55.6 GB on Hugging Face, and there are even smaller quantized versions available. Tests show that the model delivers outstanding results, even when quantized.
summary: Qwen3.6-27B 发布，一个 27B 参数的密集模型，在 Agent 编码任务上达到旗舰级性能，甚至超越前代旗舰 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B。模型仅 55.6 GB，支持量化，为开发者提供了高效、强大的编码 Agent 选择。

title: Introducing Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, powering the next wave of agents
raw_excerpt: The Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform is a comprehensive platform for building, scaling, governing, and optimizing agents. It brings together model selection, model building, and agent building capabilities together with new features for agent integration, DevOps, orchestration, and security. Agent Platform is a single destination for technical teams to build agents that can transform products, services, and operations. The agents can be delivered to employees through the Gemini Enterprise app.
summary: Google Cloud 推出 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform，一个集模型选择、构建、部署、治理和优化于一体的综合平台。该平台旨在成为智能体时代的“企业 Windows”，帮助企业大规模构建和运营 AI Agent。

title: Google debuts Workspace Intelligence for Gemini Workspace
raw_excerpt: Google launched Workspace Intelligence, enhancing Google Workspace with a semantic layer to integrate emails, chats, files, and projects for Gemini-powered agents. This update includes major product enhancements like natural-language spreadsheet building in Sheets and AI-driven features in Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Drive. Workspace Intelligence aims to make Workspace a centralized control layer for business operations, emphasizing security, context integration, and cross-application functionality.
summary: Google 发布 Workspace Intelligence，为 Gemini Workspace 增加语义层，整合邮件、聊天、文件和项目，使 Gemini Agent 能跨应用执行复杂任务。该更新包括自然语言构建电子表格等新功能，旨在将 Workspace 变为企业运营的中央控制层。

title: Introducing workspace agents in ChatGPT
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduced workspace agents in ChatGPT, allowing teams to create shared AI agents for complex tasks and workflows. These agents, powered by Codex, perform tasks like generating reports, writing code, and managing communication, while integrating with various tools like Slack. Workspace agents are currently available in research preview for select ChatGPT plans, aiming to streamline collaboration and improve productivity.
summary: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中引入 Workspace Agents，允许团队创建共享 AI Agent 以执行报告生成、代码编写等复杂工作流。这些 Agent 由 Codex 驱动，可集成 Slack 等工具，目前以研究预览形式提供。

title: Advancing Search-Augmented Language Models
raw_excerpt: Perplexity's two-stage pipeline for search-augmented language models uses initial Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize factual accuracy, user preference, and tool-use efficiency. This approach, starting with Qwen3 models, separates compliance from search improvement to achieve accuracy without compromising guardrails. The models showed enhanced accuracy on benchmarks like FRAMES and FACTS OPEN with reduced cost per query and improved efficiency in tool usage over existing models like GPT-5.4.
summary: Perplexity 发布其搜索增强语言模型的两阶段训练方法：先进行监督微调（SFT），再进行强化学习（RL），以优化事实准确性、用户偏好和工具使用效率。该方法基于 Qwen3 模型，在 FRAMES 等基准上显著提升准确性并降低成本。

title: Tencent, Alibaba to back DeepSeek at $20B+ valuation
raw_excerpt: DeepSeek is in talks for its first funding round at a $20 billion valuation, with Tencent and Alibaba interested. Tencent is seeking a 20% stake, but DeepSeek doesn't want to lose that much control. The valuation surged from $10 billion to $20 billion in days, illustrating significant investor interest.
summary: DeepSeek 正进行首轮融资谈判，估值达 200 亿美元，腾讯和阿里巴巴均有意参与。腾讯寻求 20% 股份，但 DeepSeek 不愿让渡过多控制权。估值在数天内从 100 亿升至 200 亿，凸显投资者对 AI 基础模型的狂热。

title: Anthropic just overtook OpenAI with $1 trillion valuation
raw_excerpt: Anthropic reached a $1 trillion valuation on Forge Global, surpassing OpenAI's $880 billion. The spike in Anthropic's value stems from scarce available shares and growing demand due to partnerships and increased use of its Claude Code tool. Current investor interest highlights Anthropic's position as a leading AI opportunity.
summary: Anthropic 在 Forge Global 二级市场估值达 1 万亿美元，超越 OpenAI 的 8800 亿美元。估值飙升源于稀缺股份和日益增长的需求，得益于 Claude Code 等产品的广泛采用，凸显 Anthropic 作为领先 AI 公司的地位。
